description.en: The generic carbon-fibre 5-inch quadcopter frame class: four 16 × 16 mm M3 motor mounts on a 225 mm motor-to-motor diagonal, a 30.5 × 30.5 mm stack, a 19–20 mm camera bay and 20 mm battery-strap slots. A class, not any one vendor's design.
description.es: La clase genérica de marco de cuadricóptero de 5 pulgadas en fibra de carbono: cuatro montajes de motor M3 de 16 × 16 mm sobre una diagonal de 225 mm entre motores, una pila de 30.5 × 30.5 mm, un hueco de cámara de 19–20 mm y ranuras para correa de batería de 20 mm. Una clase, no el diseño de un fabricante.
description.fr: La classe générique de châssis de quadricoptère de 5 pouces en fibre de carbone : quatre fixations moteur M3 de 16 × 16 mm sur une diagonale de 225 mm entre moteurs, une pile de 30,5 × 30,5 mm, une baie caméra de 19–20 mm et des fentes de sangle de batterie de 20 mm. Une classe, pas la conception d'un fabricant.
description.pt: A classe genérica de quadro de quadricóptero de 5 polegadas em fibra de carbono: quatro fixações de motor M3 de 16 × 16 mm numa diagonal de 225 mm entre motores, uma pilha de 30,5 × 30,5 mm, um compartimento de câmara de 19–20 mm e ranhuras de correia de bateria de 20 mm. Uma classe, não o desenho de um fabricante.

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the flight-controller stack pattern, on the top face of the arms (the face the motors and the stack sit on, z = 0). +x points forward (toward the camera), +y to the left, +z up toward the top plate. Motor mounts sit at (±motor_half_x_mm, ±motor_half_y_mm, 0), each with x_axis pointing outward along its arm; the battery-strap station on the top plate's upper face at z = top_plate_z_mm; the camera bay's side-screw axis at (camera_axis_x_mm, 0, top_plate_z_mm / 2).

wheelbase.note: motor-to-motor diagonal; the Mark4 listing states the same

notes: A COTS frame CLASS, not a design. The entry states only facts frames of this class share (225 mm motor-to-motor, 16 × 16 mm M3 motor mounts, a 30.5 × 30.5 mm stack, a 19–20 mm camera bay, 20 mm battery straps), cited from vendor listings. It copies no branded frame's outline, arm shape or plate geometry, and it carries no CAD. Positions that are not shared facts (camera axis, top-plate height, a squashed-X stretch) are parameters with conventional defaults.
